test_name: System and Services Acquisition - SA-9 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Mission-API-169
Primary NIST family: System and Services Acquisition (SA); evidence focus: SA-9.
Environment: Azure Government. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: an external provider supplied current compliance evidence but one oversight meeting minute is not yet archived. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
